parsed.rationale: Both `PlayerRateDidChangeMessage` and `HLSRateDidChangeMessage` are `type-alias-object` kinds with identical structure (`shared_field_count: 2`, `differing_slots: null`, `jaccard: null`) living in the same `Playback` package but in sibling sub-modules (`RadioPlayer/Messages/` and `HLSPlayer/Messages/`). Because they are exact duplicates within the same package and carry no restraint markers (all context flags false), a single canonical type alias `RateDidChangeMessage` can be extracted to a shared location within `Playback` (e.g., `Shared/Playback/Sources/Messages/`) and both existing aliases replaced with re-exports or direct references. This eliminates the risk of the two definitions drifting apart as the HLS and Radio player layers evolve.
